label: Ātma-Nivedana Song Four
title: ahaṁ mama-śabda-arthe jāhā kichu hoy
metaDescription: Ātma-Nivedana Song Four: (ahaṁ mama-śabda-arthe jāhā kichu hoy) of Śaraṇāgati (‘Surrender’) written by Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura in 1893. This songbook contains 50 songs detailing the six symptoms of surrender unto the lotus feet of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

verses.translation: All there is that may be indicated by the words aham (“I”) and mama (“mine”), I offer at Your lotus feet, O merciful Lord!

translit: ‘āmāra’ āmi to’ nātha! nā rohinu ār
verses.translation: I no longer consider even myself to be “mine”, O Lord! Now I have become exclusively Yours.

translit: bhāi, bandhu, dārā, suta, dravya, dwāra, ghar
verses.translation: All my possessions-body, home, servants, brothers, friends, wife, sons, personal belongings, fencing and gateways…

translit: se saba hoilo tava, āmi hoinu dās
tomāra gṛhete ebe āmi kori bās
verses.translation: …all of these things are now Yours, for I have become Your servant. I am but a mere occupant in Your house.
You are the owner of the house, and I am Your most obedient servant. My only activity now is endeavoring for Your happiness.

translit: āra mora nahe, prabhu! āmi to’ niṣkṛta
verses.translation: Whatever pious or impious activities that were performed by me, either with my gross or subtle bodies, are no longer mine, O Lord, for I am redeemed!
My will has become merged with Your will. From this day forward Bhaktivinoda has completely for-gotten himself.
